title: Anthropic updates Claude voice mode with more capable models
summary: Claude's new voice model will let you reschedule your meeting or draft an email.
llm_summary: Anthropic has updated its Claude voice model, allowing for more advanced capabilities such as rescheduling meetings and drafting emails. This upgrade aims to make the AI more useful in real-world scenarios, enabling users to perform tasks with greater ease and efficiency. The updated model is a step towards making AI-powered virtual assistants more practical and user-friendly.
